criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: An organization dedicated to education, including schools, colleges, and universities.

categories.name: Political Figure
categories.definition: An individual involved in politics, including elected officials and political activists.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture or movie, including feature films, documentaries, and film series.

categories.name: Music Album
categories.definition: A collection of audio recordings released as a single item, typically by a music artist or band.

categories.name: Plant Species
categories.definition: A specific type of plant, including trees, shrubs, and flowering plants.

categories.name: Animal Species
categories.definition: A specific type of animal, including mammals, birds, reptiles, and insects.

categories.name: Village or Town
categories.definition: A small settlement or community, typically smaller than a city.

categories.name: Historical Site
categories.definition: A location of historical significance, including buildings, monuments, and archaeological sites.

categories.name: Company or Organization
categories.definition: A business or group formed for a specific purpose, including corporations, non-profits, and government entities.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A written or printed work consisting of pages bound together, including novels, non-fiction, and academic texts.

categories.name: Sports Team or Athlete
categories.definition: An organized group of athletes or an individual athlete participating in competitive sports.

categories.name: Religious Institution
categories.definition: An organization dedicated to religious activities, including churches, synagogues, and temples.

categories.name: Journal or Periodical
categories.definition: A publication issued at regular intervals, typically containing articles and research on specific subjects.

categories.name: Government Building
categories.definition: A structure used for governmental purposes, including offices, courthouses, and legislative buildings.

categories.name: Museum
categories.definition: An institution that conserves and displays artifacts and objects of artistic, cultural, historical, or scientific significance.

categories.name: Television Show or Series
categories.definition: A program produced for broadcast on television, including dramas, comedies, and reality shows.

categories.name: River or Waterway
categories.definition: A natural flowing body of water, including rivers, streams, and lakes.

categories.name: Mountain or Peak
categories.definition: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface, typically rising prominently above its surroundings.

categories.name: Historical Figure
categories.definition: An individual who has had a significant impact on history, including leaders, inventors, and cultural icons.

categories.name: Documentary
categories.definition: A non-fiction film or television program that provides a factual report on a particular subject.
